The white pieces have a crude, thick black stroke that creates a 'sticker' effect, while the black pieces have a heavy, inconsistent drop shadow that makes them look like they are floating rather than sitting on the board. 2. **Color System Incoherence**: The board palette (slate blue and light grey) clashes with the UI palette (deep charcoal and mustard gold). There is no shared visual language; the board feels like a separate, lower-quality asset pasted onto the screen. 3. **Typography & Hierarchy**: The 'GRANDMASTER' header uses a wide, stretched sans-serif that feels dated and unpolished. The 'New Game' and 'Flip Board' buttons have a faint border that is barely visible against the dark background, while the 'Analyze Position' button uses a flat, muddy mustard color that feels disconnected from the rest of the interface. 5. **Spacing & Layout**: The move history area is a large, empty void with a faint border that adds no value.
